text.tspan: Semantic root, execution root and state revision have different meanings. An unchanged execution root does not mean an unspent nonce.
Quint models concurrent publication and restart. Lean preserves state/context alignment and logical-operation continuity under explicit physical premises.
Unknown spends too / no handle yet
